'''''Making a Killing''''' was an autobiography written by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]]. It chronicled his rise to the top of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
